purpose: Prove Approved Instruction promotion and supersession locally: one memory candidate is promoted to an active Approved Instruction (CAI-LOCAL-001) via a human/Doug approval receipt carrying authority basis, rationale, and source evidence; then a replacement instruction (CAI-LOCAL-002) is approved via a NEW receipt, and the prior instruction is marked superseded with a link to the new instruction plus a dedicated supersession receipt. The prior instruction text and its original approval receipt stay byte-identical, PROVEN by a three-way content match against an append-only-locked freeze recorded on the original approval receipt (approvedInstructionSnapshot) at promotion time; supersession never overwrites. Receipts here are local contract evidence only, and every live mutation stays receipt-gated to Epic 2.

sourceCandidateCoordination.note: Story 4-3 (promote memory candidates) slice IS co-located as memory-candidates-slice.json. Its two declared candidates (one rejected, one needs-clarification) are not in an approved/promotable review state and cover different topics (multi-typed work-item extraction and Outlook thread drift), so none is a suitable source candidate for THIS Approved Instruction (tenant readiness checklist cadence). This slice therefore embeds a self-contained candidate CMC-LOCAL-PROMO-001, chosen to be non-colliding with 4-3's CMC ids. The validator harvests 4-3's CMC ids from $PSScriptRoot and rejects collisions; promotion does not hard-depend on any 4-3 candidate id.

receiptVerbPolicy.localExtensionNote: The manifest com_receiptverb vocabulary has no instruction-scoped supersession verb. The supersession status-move receipt reuses the manifest verb 'memory_promoted' as a deliberate local extension to record the active->superseded status move on an Approved Instruction; com_result=superseded and com_before_state=active/com_after_state=superseded disambiguate this from a memory promotion. This is a documented local extension, NOT a claim that the meaning graph owns instruction workflow state; guards.meaningGraphDoesNotOwnWorkflowState and guards.noWorkItemStateChangeInThisSlice remain true.
